mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of decreasing FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of decreasing PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals strong economic growth with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of joint increase in GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL.
